MP Harbhajan Singh's 'Zombie Drug' Video Fact-Checked by Punjab Police

A video shared by BJP MP Harbhajan Singh, claiming to show a 'zombie drug' affecting Punjab, was fact-checked by the Punjab Police. The police stated the video was filmed in Rajasthan, not Punjab. Singh subsequently urged the Punjab government to focus on the drug menace. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) also responded to Singh's post.
